Name: SDV Maps Haru - Tiled
Author: HaruNesukts
Description:
[center][/center]
[center]﻿[b]Creating maps with Tiled can often involve tedious, repetitive tasks such as animations, tile properties, and fixing tilesheet paths. This extension makes it more accessible.

[/b]This adds options such as copying animations, properties, adding lights, doors, warp, changing tiles for day and night, adding smart copying between maps, and more.
More information below 

[size=3]If you want to contribute an idea, you can comment on a post[/size]

[b][size=3]Manual[/size]
[/b]
[b]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/2URTFZi.png[/img]
﻿

[/b][b]Fix Tilesheets[/b]
Automatically repairs tilesheet paths when the image is located in the same folder as the map.

[b]Choose Folder[/b]
Choose a folder to replace all the Tilesheet sheets


[img]https://i.imgur.com/EAhJcYt.png[/img]
﻿
[b]Generate Base Layers and Layers Objects[/b]
Creates all the standard [i]normal layers[/i] needed for a map, such as:
Back, Buildings, Paths, Front, AlwaysFront


[b]Organize All Layers[/b]
Automatically organizes every layer in the map, whether normal or object, for a cleaner workflow.
[b]

Add Extra Level[/b]
Allows you to duplicate a selected layer to create additional levels.
Back2, Back3, etc.
Works with normal layers only (not object layers).



[img]https://i.imgur.com/ciNs8Ut.png[/img]

[b]Add Tile Animation/Remove Tile Animation
[/b]
[b]Add Tile Animation:[/b] Automatically generates animations for selected tiles.
[b]Remove Tile Animation:[/b] Clears all animation frames from the selected tiles.a

[b]Direction:[/b] Determines where the script looks for the subsequent animation frames (Right, Down, Left, Up).

[b]Number of Frames:[/b] The total count of frames including the starting one.
[b]Frame Duration:[/b] The speed of the animation measured in milliseconds (ms).

[b]Stride:[/b] [b]Auto:[/b] The script automatically calculates the ID offset (e.g., if moving Down, it skips the number of tiles in a row).
[b]Stride: Custom:[/b] You define the ID offset manually. Useful if your animation frames are non-adjacent (e.g., every 4 tiles).

[b]Use Copy Mode:[/b] Designed for complex or large objects (like a 2x2 multi-tile door).
You select the "target" tiles and provide a [b]Start Tile ID[/b]. The script will map the animation frames from that source area to your selection.


[b]Smart Paste[/b]
It basically does an intelligent paste of any tile you’ve copied and then pasted on your map using the tileset you’ve already created.

[color=#00ff00]Enable[/color]/[color=#ff0000]Disable[/color]

Default = [color=#00ff00]Enable[/color]


[b]Copy Tileset All Animations[/b]
Copies all animations from the currently opened tilesheet.


[b]Paste Tileset All Animations[/b]
Pastes previously copied animations into the target tilesheet.


[b]Copy Tileset Custom Propierties[/b]
﻿Right-click to copy the selected tiles


[b]﻿Copy Tileset Custom Propierties[/b]
﻿Right-click to paste the selected tiles


[b]Delete Animation Tilesets[/b]
You can remove the tile animations with a right click


[b]Copy Tileset Animations With Selected Area[/b]
You can copy the tile animations with a right click


[b]Paste Tileset Animations With Selected Area[/b]
You can paste the tile animations with a right click

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ua587QO.png[/img]

[b]Ghost Tile[/b]
Used for tiles without images or what I call ghost tiles, it is found in [b]Layers -> Ghost Tile Finder[/b].[b] [/b]You can remove it from one or from everyone

[b]Light and BrookSounds
[/b]
Select [b]Rectangular Select,[/b] choose a position, then go to[b] [/b][b]Layer [/b]→ [b]Add Light Sources or BrookSounds[/b]. And choose the type of light or type of sound.
﻿

[b]DayTiles and NightTiles
[/b]
Select [b]Rectangular Select[/b], choose a layer, then go to [b]Layer → Add Stardew Day/Night Tiles[/b].This adds the [b]DayTiles[/b] and [b]NightTiles[/b] properties (if they already exist, it just adds values without replacing them).It also copies the [b]position[/b] and the [b]selected tile[/b]. The tilesheets currently available are:

[list]
[*][code]Vanilla Tilesheets[/code][/*]
[*][code]Lumisteria Tilesheets[/code][/*]
[*][code]PC's Tilesheets[/code][/*]
[*][code]Crystalinerose Tilesheets[/code][/*]
[*][code]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/code][/*]
[/list]

[b]Warp﻿[/b]  ﻿
Use [b]Rectangular Select[/b], choose a position, then go to [b]Layer → One Warp or Multi Warp[/b] to copy map coordinates. It’s not always useful, but available if needed.


[b]Doors[/b]

Use [b]Rectangular Select[/b], select the layer with the door (bottom tile), then go to [b]Layer → Add Selection To Doors Property[/b]. It will copy the coordinates, tilesheet, and tile ID.

Example:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a5mqrQP.png[/img]﻿



Thanks for checking out the mod! If you liked it, feel free to give an [b]endorsement[/b] and follow it.

[b]Warning:[/b]  [color=#ea9999]This is not a [i]Stardew Valley[/i] mod, but a [b]Tiled plugin[/b] that helps create maps and shortcuts for [i]Stardew Valley[/i]. It's especially for map creators/modders[/color]

Downloads.Description:
To install this extension, follow these steps:

Open the Tiled program.

Go to Edit > Preferences > Plugins.

Scroll down to the Extensions section.

Copy the compressed folder of the extension into that directory.
